theorems.name: StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.ChunkedCoverageAndSummarySound
theorems.type: (∀ c total slot, 0 < c → slot < total → (∃ r ∈ StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedPartition c total, r.contains slot) ∧ (∀ k₁ k₂, (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedChunk c total k₁).contains slot → (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fixedChunk c total k₂).contains slot → k₁ = k₂)) ∧ (∀ (V α : Type) (hash : List (Nat × List V) → α) (p : StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.PhysicalChunk V) (newLocator : Nat), hash (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.consolidate p newLocator)) = hash (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.canonical p)) ∧ (∀ (R K : Type) [DecidableEq K] (keys : R → List K) (k : K) (chunks : List (StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.SummarizedChunk R K)), (∀ ch ∈ chunks, ch.summary = StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.derive keys ch.records) → StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.prunedScan keys k chunks = StoreM4.ChunkedCoverage.fullScan keys k chunks)
